MG5 CASE SUMMARY - MAIN NARRATIVE
The Crown allege Riley North struck Simon Hale with a broken bottle outside The Foundry public house. Co-defendant
Milo Trent is alleged to have blocked the doorway. The prosecution say the injury was intentional and serious. Riley says
Simon swung first, he moved backwards, and there was a struggle near broken glass. Riley denies intending serious
injury.
There is CCTV from the exterior doorway but the interior camera was not working. Several pages mention "CCTV exists"
without distinguishing exterior CCTV from missing interior CCTV. The app must not say interior CCTV exists or proves
the defence.
Medical material is incomplete: ambulance note served, triage note served, final consultant report absent. Photographs
show a cut but severity and causation should remain provisional until the full medical report is served.
MG11 WITNESS STATEMENT - Complainant - Simon Hale
Statement status: Signed. Witness: Complainant - Simon Hale.
I remember Riley coming towards me. I had been arguing with him. I do not accept that I swung first. I was drinking and
the doorway was crowded.
I think Milo was near the door but I cannot say exactly where Riley was standing when the glass broke.
MG11 WITNESS STATEMENT - Door staff - Amber Noel
Statement status: Draft / unsigned. Witness: Door staff - Amber Noel.
My view was partly blocked by customers. I saw pushing and then Simon holding his face. I cannot say if the bottle was
already broken before contact.
I told police the interior camera had not been working for several weeks. Exterior camera faces the doorway but not the
bar interior.
MG11 WITNESS STATEMENT - PC Lewis Penn
Statement status: Draft / unsigned. Witness: PC Lewis Penn.

I seized a broken bottle from near the doorway. Exhibit code LP/4 appears on one continuity sheet and LP/14 appears on
a later property record. This needs checking before any strong continuity point is taken.

CUSTODY / INTERVIEW EXTRACT
Defendant: Riley North. Interview summary prepared from custody log and interview note. Full audio and transcript are
not served in this bundle.
Q: Did you intentionally hit Simon Hale with a bottle?
A: No. He swung first and everything happened fast near the doorway.
Q: Did you have a bottle in your hand?
A: I had a drink before, but I did not use it as a weapon.
Q: Why is there blood on your sleeve?
A: I was close to him after he was cut. People were pushing.
Q: Did Milo block the door?
A: No comment.
